judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Short, colloquial shop greetings with capitalised sentences after ellipses, a mild 'damn' and a capital-U 'Undead' all fit Nox's shopkeepers. 'I reckon I may have a sword or two lying about' and 'Undead at our gates' lean a little toward stock fantasy phrasing, so this is a weak call.
